# Fidelity Investments

> Fidelity Investments provides comprehensive retirement planning, investment management, brokerage services, and wealth management solutions for individuals and institutions.

Fidelity offers a full suite of financial services including retirement accounts (IRAs, 401(k)s, Roth conversions), investment products (ETFs, mutual funds, stocks, bonds), and financial planning tools. The platform serves as a one-stop destination for retirement savings, investment management, and personalized financial guidance.

## Key Topics

- Roth IRA
- 401(k) Rollover
- Traditional IRA
- Retirement Planning
- IRA Transfer
- Inherited IRAs
- 529 College Savings
- Health Savings Account (HSA)
- ETFs
- Mutual Funds
- Brokerage Account
- Financial Planning
- Wealth Management
- Commission-Free Trading
- Retirement Income

## Retirement Planning & Accounts

- [Retirement Planning | Preparing For Retirement](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement/retirement-planning): Retirement planning strategies with Roth IRA, Traditional IRA, and 401(k) options.
- [Retirement Accounts | Plan & Save For Retirement](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement/retirement-accounts): Overview of retirement account options including Roth IRA, Traditional IRA, and Inherited IRAs.
- [401(k) Rollover & IRA Transfer | Simplify Retirement](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement/401k-rollover): Guide to 401(k) rollovers, IRA transfers, and Roth conversions for account consolidation.

## Financial Planning & Wealth Management

- [Financial Planning | Get Started With a Free Plan](https://www.fidelity.com/what-we-offer/planning): Financial planning tool offering flexible plans around IRAs and brokerage accounts.

## Financial Education & Resources

- [Personal Finance and Financial Basics](https://www.fidelity.com/financial-basics/overview): Educational guide covering budgeting, debt management, and personal finance basics.

## Overview

- [Fidelity Investments - Retirement Plans, Investing, Brokerage, Wealth Management, Financial Planning and Advice, Online Trading](https://www.fidelity.com): Fidelity Investments homepage offering retirement, investing, brokerage, and wealth management services.
